title: Sign-in and access
text:
What is the GQI Portal?
The intelligence platform from the team that publishes QCR. Your QCR account includes a free preview of it.
How do I sign in?
Through GQI Portal, with your QCR or GQI account. Start from any Sign in link on QCR. If you are already signed in on QCR, you are not asked for your QCR password again. If you hold a QCR account and a GQI account with the same email, you verify the other account once and they are linked.
Does my QCR membership change?
No. Membership, billing and access to QCR content stay as they are, and your QCR subscription applies in GQI Portal wherever QCR content lives.
Where are Players and Scorecards?
In GQI Portal. Saved QCR links open the matching Portal page.
Does linking accounts add GQI access?
No. Linking joins your sign-in, not your plans. Paid GQI Portal access comes with a GQI subscription. An active GQI Internal account also includes QCR premium content.
